subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery land as the narrow `channel-info`/`channel-list` pair using the existing `channelInfo` gate, or as part of the broader advanced-action surface in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79818?
rationale: Current main is missing the requested behavior, but the only live same-repo implementation path is a broad protected PR with additional config, auth, and security-boundary implications that automation should not decide.

options.title: Split to a narrow action-pair change
options.body: Implement only `channel-info` and `channel-list` in `extensions/slack` with focused runtime, docs, and tests before revisiting the larger action set.

options.title: Continue with the broad parity PR
options.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79818 as the canonical vehicle, accepting the larger compatibility/security review surface.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery actions
options.body: Leave the issue open as a product backlog item until maintainers decide the Slack action surface should expand.

recommendation.title: Split to a narrow action-pair change
recommendation.body: Implement only `channel-info` and `channel-list` in `extensions/slack` with focused runtime, docs, and tests before revisiting the larger action set.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the currently open broad Slack parity branch and appears frequently in recent Slack action/docs history.
